prayers.versiculumAngelusPrimus: The Angel of the Lord declared unto Mary.
prayers.responsiumAngelusPrimus: And she conceived of the Holy Spirit.
prayers.versiculumAngelusSecundus: Behold the handmaid of the Lord.
prayers.responsiumAngelusSecundus: Be it done unto me according to Thy word.
prayers.versiculumAngelusTertius: And the Word was made Flesh.
prayers.versiculumStandard: Pray for us, O holy Mother of God.
prayers.responsiumStandard: That we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ.
prayers.collectaAngelus: Let us pray. Pour forth, we beseech Thee, O Lord, Thy grace into our hearts; that we, to whom the Incarnation of Christ Thy Son was made known by the message of an angel, may by His Passion and Cross be brought to the glory of His Resurrection. Through the same Christ our Lord. Amen.
prayers.reginaCaeli: Queen of Heaven, rejoice, alleluia. For He whom you did merit to bear, alleluia, has risen as He said, alleluia. Pray for us to God, alleluia.
prayers.versiculumPaschale: Rejoice and be glad, O Virgin Mary, alleluia.
prayers.responsiumPaschale: For the Lord has truly risen, alleluia.
prayers.collectaPaschale: Let us pray. O God, who through the resurrection of Your Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, did vouchsafe to give joy to the whole world; grant, we beseech You, that through the intercession of the Virgin Mary, His Mother, we may lay hold of the joys of everlasting life, through the same Christ our Lord. Amen.
